headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearBlock_le_linear
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  have p :=
    Fintype.card
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys)));
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearBlock xs ys ≤ 4 * p

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearAttempts_le_old
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearAttempts xs ys t ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceOuterAttempts xs ys t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinear_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    ∀
      (start :
        Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)
      (t : ℕ),
      (1 - Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCorrectionSuccess xs ys) ^
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearAttempts xs ys t +
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearAttempts xs ys t) *
            (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearPrecision xs ys t) +
              Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearPrecision xs ys t)) ≤
        Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearScheduled_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (start :
    Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)
  (fallback :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys))
  (t : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearScheduledLaw xs ys hb start fallback t)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
